The '''Arakyd Special''' was a special model of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] that [[Walon Vau]] stole from the [[Dressian Kiolsh Merchant Bank]]. It was said that Vau's [[Grandfather Vau|grandfather]] shot and killed a servant with the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], though this is up for debate as [[Kal Skirata]] believed Vau told him that to anger him.
